messages:
Ana Carter: Heads-up — PartnerCorp says customers got duplicate credits for 2025-02-10 usage window. They pushed a backfill yesterday and then our ledger applied partner webhook batch again. Can we triage?
Mike Liu: ugh. do we know if it's duplicate events or a replay?
Olivia Park: Partner sent two payload types: hourly snapshots and a daily rollup. We ingest hourly and also accept partner rollups if flag=rollup. Looks like the rollup overlapped earlier hourly windows for a small subset.
Raj Singh: marketplace-bot just posted delivery failures around 02:12 UTC — some retries happened and partner re-sent the rollup. Could be a retry dedupe gap.
marketplace-bot: webhook delivery failed for partner-corp (HTTP 500) at 2025-02-11T02:12:09Z, retry scheduled.
Tess Morgan: Key question: do we dedupe on (partner_id, usage_id) or by (fingerprint of events + window)? Our current dedupe is by usage_id only, and partner sometimes strips usage_id on rollups.
Ana Carter: PartnerCorp acknowledges they didn't set usage_id on rollups. They used timestamp-based keys. Partner-corp-bot: We re-sent the daily rollup after seeing 500s; original hourly events were already accepted by Redwood. We're happy to revoke duplicates.
Mike Liu: Can partner send a revocation batch? We have a revoke API but need to validate idempotency. If they can produce event-level ids we can auto-reverse.
Olivia Park: Until then, ops note: mark affected accounts as "hold credits" to avoid customer-facing statements. Also need to run a constrained ledger diff for 2025-02-10 to find duplicates.
Raj Singh: I ran a quick query: ~1.2k records with matching (customer_id, tokens) across hourly+rollup for that day. Looks like 0.8% of partner volume. Attaching sample payload that caused duplication:

```
{
  "partner": "partner-corp",
  "window_start": "2025-02-10T00:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2025-02-10T23:59:59Z",
  "rollup": true,
  "usage_id": null,
  "total_tokens": 123456,
  "events": null
}
```

Raj Singh: and example hourly record we got earlier had usage_id set.
Tess Morgan: Two immediate asks for Partner team: 1) stop sending rollups until we agree dedupe rules; 2) emit a revocation file with original usage_ids for the hourly events (if available).
partner-corp-bot: Acknowledged. We'll pause rollups and generate a revocation file by EOD PST. We'll also add usage_id to future rollups.
Mike Liu: Engineering plan: add a defensive rule to treat rollup with null usage_id as "potential_replay" and require manual reconciliation. Also add a short-lived guard to prevent auto-crediting rollups if hourlys already seen for same window.
Ana Carter: Can we scope timeline? Ops needs an ETA on revocation + ledger fix or we'll need to issue provisional credits.
partner-corp-bot: Revocation file ETA 2025-02-11T20:00:00-08:00.
Olivia Park: We'll run the ledger diff once file is in. Raj — can you prepare the SQL that matches duplicates and outputs (customer_id, partner_claim_id, amount, source_ids)?
Raj Singh: on it. I'll push a query gist and share in this thread shortly.
Mike Liu: Also logging action: add a webhook-contract test that simulates partner 500 + retry + rollup to reproduce. Olivia can own test matrix.
Olivia Park: Ack — I'll add integration test cases to the partner onboarding suite and a mock harness for rollups.
Tess Morgan: Customer comms: I'll draft a holding notice for impacted customers (language: "we're reviewing unexpected credits and will reconcile; no action required").
Ana Carter: Thanks all. Once revocation arrives, Raj and Olivia run detection+reversal plan, Mike deploys temporary guard, Tess preps comms. Ping me when any blockers. :thumbsup:
Mike Liu: noted. tagging @Ana Carter for follow-ups.
partner-corp-bot: Revocation file uploaded to S3: s3://partner-corp-revokes/2025-02-11/revokes-2025-02-10.json (signed link sent to eng@redwood).
Ana Carter: Received. Raj/Olivia please proceed. I'll stand by for ledger diff and final customer list.
Raj Singh: running diff now, will post results in ~25m.
Olivia Park: I'll extend the test harness and validate the revocation format. Expected fields: usage_id, customer_id, adjusted_tokens, original_batch_id. If any missing, we fallback to per-customer manual reconciliation.
Raj Singh: Diff complete: 1,238 duplicate credit entries found across 412 customers, total tokens duplicated: 1,037,904. I'll generate reversal ops and a safe cutover plan.
Tess Morgan: draft comms ready, sending to legal for sign-off.
Mike Liu: planning a hotfix branch for the guard + new dedupe logic; will cut PR after Olivia confirms test harness.
Ana Carter: Great work. We'll close loop after reversal. If anyone finds additional partner rollups in the past 30 days, flag here.
Olivia Park: quick note for long-term: ask partners to always include per-event usage_id and a rollup_id. Also add a spec clause: rollup must include source_batch_ids to allow dedupe.
partner-corp-bot: We're updating our exporter to include usage_id and source_batch_ids in rollups starting next week. Thanks for quick turnaround.
Ana Carter: Closing interim ops: pause auto-rollup ingestion for partner-corp until PR is live. We'll reopen after tests.
Mike Liu: will follow up with PR link.
Tess Morgan: I'll hold customer comms until reversal is performed.
Ana Carter: Thanks everyone. End of thread.
